name: mot17_val_half
rationale: MOT17 test has no public ground truth, so evaluation uses a fixed split of MOT17-train. We adopt the widely-used 'val-half' convention (as in ByteTrack/FairMOT): the FIRST half of each of the 7 train videos is 'train', the SECOND half is 'val'. Splitting *within* each video (rather than holding out whole videos) keeps every scene/camera represented in both halves, and makes our val numbers directly comparable to published 'MOT17 val-half' results. Frame ranges are 1-indexed and inclusive; the split point is floor(length/2). Ground truth is shared across the three public-detector variants (DPM/FRCNN/SDP) of each video, so the split is keyed by the base video id.
